method: OrbStack Linux native data volume, 8 CPUs, 8 GiB, GOMAXPROCS=2 per replica; 1002 entities, 4 writers and 16 readers, 20 host/service groups per batch; 5s read warmup, 30s measurement plus tail; before1/after/before2 with order reversed in round 2. Same host has unrelated workloads.
application_metric_contract: Successful applied log entries and application transactions, summed across replicas, sampled sequentially before and after each load. Includes control and empty entries. Counters reset on restart. Baseline has no counters and is null.
limitations: One OrbStack host, small fixed graph, 4 writers and 16 readers. Baseline calibration varies substantially in some rounds. No cross-host, large graph, sustained capacity, real disk failure, or general rolling upgrade qualification.
